info.name: PAR Punchh Mobile Check-In Users API
info.description:
The PAR Punchh Mobile API powers business-branded mobile apps and websites, exposing guest-facing loyalty functions such as user registration and sign-in, profile management, check-ins/transactions, and offer management. Access requires partner certification and business-issued OAuth client credentials. All calls are signed with an HMAC-SHA256 `x-pch-digest` header. Base URLs (sandbox and production) are provided by a Punchh representative.

Contact Support:
 Name: PAR Developer Portal
